subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The fields are full of crops __existing in large quantities__.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**that are abundant**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abundant **is an adjective that describes the presence of something in large quantities or in a plentiful supply. (किसी चीज़ की बड़ी मात्रा में या प्रचुर आपूर्ति में उपस्थिति)
 
• When something is abundant, there is more than enough of it, and it exceeds what is necessary or expected. 
 
 
• **Example**: *The region is known for its abundant natural resources.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence "Abundant means existing in large quantities, which perfectly fits the context of the sentence.

Thus, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Sufficient**: Adequate or enough to meet a particular need or requirement. (किसी विशेष आवश्यकता या आवश्यकता को पूरा करने के लिए पर्याप्त या पर्याप्त)

 
 
• 
 
**Limited**: Restricted in quantity, scope, or extent; not abundant or vast. (मात्रा, दायरे या सीमा में सीमित; प्रचुर या विशाल नहीं)

 
 
• 
 
**Customized**: Tailored or modified to meet specific preferences or requirements. (विशिष्ट प्राथमिकताओं या आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के लिए तैयार या संशोधित किया गया)
